events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival began on this day in 1969, bringing together hundreds of thousands for a legendary weekend of peace and music.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Imagine being at Woodstock in '69. Three days of peace, love, and incredible music. What track defines that era for you?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost the one and only Elvis Presley. His impact on music is still felt today. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: The hip-hop world remembers iconic rapper Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996 and passed away six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Influence
angles.copy: 30 years since the tragic shooting of Tupac Shakur. His powerful lyrics and influence continue to resonate. What's his most iconic track for you?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His guitar work changed music forever. Which of his tracks still gives you chills?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is as famous as the music within. What's your go-to track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking with The Pretenders. What's your favourite song from her incredible career?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that swagger. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo hit?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' as a single in the US on October 11, 1971, and the album on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace. What does it mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Remember Your First iPod?
angles.copy: 25 years since the original iPod dropped! It changed everything for music on the go. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Fans worldwide celebrate James Bond Day, marking the 1962 premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your all-time favourite Bond moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The world remembers John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedy is timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What are your hidden gems from this double album?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world pays tribute to Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Queen's Legacy
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the unforgettable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?
